title: Closing a page item keeps the owner's saved answer, so a lane's relayed-grant check can still read it
why: Incident 13:52 CST Nov 12: triage closed item 618 and deleted answers/batch-label-allow-text (practice since 12:34 CST: closing deletes the answers doc); lane batch-label-setter's page_grant.py then printed "not counted: no saved answer", so the owner had to save again (item reopened 13:54 CST).
note: Fix: the page writer deletes an answers doc only on reopen or reword, never on close; a check in the writer path refuses a close that deletes it. Red first on the 618 sequence. Home: skill waiting-page.
